name: Linked List Intersection Point
description: Finds the node where two linked lists intersect using the two-pointer equalization technique.
aim: Find the intersection by having both pointers travel the same total distance: when one list ends, redirect to the other list's head.
howItWorks: Use two pointers p1 (starts at head1) and p2 (starts at head2)
Advance both one step at a time
When either reaches null, redirect to the other list's head
They will meet at the intersection node (or both become null = no intersection)

time.averageCase: Each pointer traverses at most n+m nodes

realWorld: Detecting shared objects in memory graphs
Finding common prefix in file system paths
whenToUse: Find merge point of two linked lists in O(1) space
alternatives: Hash set — store all nodes of one list, scan other O(n+m) time O(n) space
